judged_text: Email dispatch failures are swallowed with console.log('Error sending AddGuestsEmails'), discarding the error object and bypassing the structured logger. In production an email-provider outage is invisible: users get the success toast, no attendee is notified, and support has no error detail to diagnose with because the caught error is never logged.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which discards the `err` object and uses `console.log` instead of any structured logging. Because the handler still returns `{ message: "Guests added" }` and the UI toasts success on mutation success, an email-provider failure would not surface to users/support beyond that generic console line.
